name: "Update Space Shooter Game"

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 * * * *"   # Hourly
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/arcade.yml"

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  arcade:
    name: "🎮 Generate Space Shooter"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

    steps:
      - name: "📥 Checkout repository"
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: "📁 Prepare output directory"
        run: mkdir -p dist

      - name: "🎮 Generate Space Shooter"
        uses: czl9707/gh-space-shooter@main
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          output-path: "dist/gh-space-shooter.webp"
          strategy: "random"
          no-commit: true

      - name: "🚀 Commit & Push Updated Game"
        env:
          SIGNING_KEY: ${{ secrets.COMMIT_SIGNING_KEY }}
          BRANCH: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail

          if [[ ! -f "dist/gh-space-shooter.webp" ]]; then
            echo "::error::File dist/gh-space-shooter.webp gagal dibuat."
            exit 1
          fi

          git config user.name "RusdiEneri"
          git config user.email "nuruddinrusydiilham@gmail.com"

          # SSH Commit Signing jika secret tersedia
          if [[ -n "${SIGNING_KEY:-}" ]]; then
            KEY_FILE="$(mktemp)"
            printf '%s\n' "$SIGNING_KEY" > "$KEY_FILE"
            chmod 600 "$KEY_FILE"
            git config gpg.format ssh
            git config gpg.ssh.program ssh-keygen
            git config user.signingkey "$KEY_FILE"
            git config commit.gpgsign true
            echo "✅ SSH signing enabled."
          fi

          git add -f dist/gh-space-shooter.webp
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "Tidak ada perubahan pada game. Lewati commit."
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "chore(game): update space shooter arcade simulation [skip ci]"

          for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            git pull --rebase origin "$BRANCH" || true
            if git push origin "$BRANCH"; then
              echo "✅ Push berhasil pada percobaan $i"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 5
          done

          exit 1
